journey.title: From one Visnagar clinic to
journey.lede: Aakash Eye Hospital opened in Visnagar in 1993 as a single-doctor hospital. Every step since has been about bringing better diagnostics and surgical care closer to the patients who need them.
journey.milestonesTitle: How the hospital kept moving forward
journey.milestonesLede: The technology, the team and the hospitals that shaped Aakash Eye Hospital. Pick a year to jump straight to it.

milestones.title: The beginning
milestones.description: Dr. Vishnu S. Patel founded Aakash Eye Hospital in Visnagar, to give affordable, ethical, quality eye care to all.
milestones.alt: The Aakash Eye Hospital building in Visnagar, with the Gujarati signboard over the entrance

milestones.title: Pioneering cataract surgery
milestones.description: One of the early pioneers of small incision cataract surgery (SICS). The first phaco machine followed in 1998, and the Sovereign phaco system in 2000.
milestones.alt: A phacoemulsification machine for cataract surgery, with its foot pedal

milestones.title: Laser vision correction
milestones.description: LASIK began at iVue Laser Vision, Surat, on VISX excimer laser technology, and came to Visnagar as iLook Vision in 2008.
milestones.alt: An excimer laser workstation for laser vision correction, with its patient bed

milestones.title: From one doctor to a team
milestones.description: Dr. Sanjay B. Patel joined, turning a single-doctor practice into a multi-doctor hospital. Dr. Ashesh Patel (2012) and Dr. Saurabh Kapoor (2013) followed.
milestones.alt: Patients and families outside the consulting rooms in the atrium at Aakash Eye Hospital Visnagar

milestones.title: Odhav, Ahmedabad
milestones.description: The first hospital beyond Visnagar opened at Odhav under Dr. Sanjay B. Patel and Dr. Saurabh Kapoor, as Visnagar moved into its new building.
milestones.alt: The Aakash Eye Hospital signboard on Siddhi Vinayak Arcade at Odhav Circle, above the HDFC Bank branch

milestones.title: Femtosecond laser and retina care
milestones.description: The Ziemer Z8 femtosecond laser brought laser-assisted cataract surgery and Femto LASIK, and retina services began at Visnagar and Odhav under Dr. Dhaivat Vasavada.
milestones.alt: The Ziemer Femto LDV Z8 femtosecond laser

milestones.title: Bharuch
milestones.description: Aakash Eye Hospital Bharuch opened under Dr. Ashesh Patel, who joined at Visnagar in 2012, with Dr. Gaurang Amin.
milestones.alt: The Aakash Eye Hospital signboard, in Gujarati and English, on the corner building in Bharuch above the Lifeline Diagnostic laboratory

milestones.title: The next generation
milestones.description: Dr. Aakash V. Patel and Dr. Toral A. Patel joined, and in 2020 Dr. Nirav Zala strengthened the retina team.
milestones.alt: The first-floor walkway over the atrium at Aakash Eye Hospital Visnagar

milestones.title: Precision cataract care
milestones.description: The ZEISS IOLMaster 700 arrived in 2022. In 2024 came the Veritas phaco system, the IOLMaster 700 TK and a dedicated oculoplasty department.
milestones.alt: ZEISS optical biometry instruments that measure the eye before cataract surgery

milestones.title: Himmatnagar
milestones.description: Opened under Dr. Ronak Patel, who joined at Visnagar in 2022.
milestones.alt: The Aakash Eye Hospital signboard across the glass front of Upadhyay M.A. Corporate House, Himmatnagar

milestones.title: Gota, Ahmedabad
milestones.description: A second hospital in Ahmedabad, opened with Dr. Kshitij Gandhi.
milestones.alt: The Aakash Eye Hospital signboard among the signs on the building in Gota, above the Bank of Baroda branch

milestones.title: Juhapura, Ahmedabad
milestones.description: Opened under Dr. Faizurraheman Chauhan, who joined at Visnagar in 2019.
milestones.alt: The Aakash Eye Hospital signboard on the corner of Amber Tower at Blue Water Complex, Sarkhej

now.label: Today
now.title: One vision, growing together
now.description: From one doctor in Visnagar to a network of eye hospitals, with primary eye care centres at Mansa and Khedbrahma and surgical outreach at Vijapur.
now.alt: Patients waiting in the double-height hall at Aakash Eye Hospital Visnagar

vision.title: Why this hospital
vision.lede: Two sentences decide how this hospital is run - what we owe the patient in front of us today, and the institution we are building for the patients who come after.
vision.statementsTitle: The two sentences behind every decision

statements.text: To improve lives through compassionate eye care by combining skilled professionals, modern technology, evidence-based medicine, and a patient-first culture. We are committed to recommending only what our patients truly need, delivering consistent quality across every Aakash Eye Hospital, and continuously learning, improving, and innovating to serve future generations better.
statements.highlight: recommending only what our patients truly need
statements.note: What we work on every day.

statements.text: To bring Aakash Eye Hospital's way of practising medicine to as many people as possible by building one of the world's most trusted eye care institutions - where affordable, ethical, and uncompromised quality care remains the foundation of every decision.
statements.highlight: one of the world's most trusted eye care institutions
statements.note: Where we are taking the hospital.

vision.valuesLede: Six operating rules. Each one is quoted from the mission or the vision above, not written alongside them.

values.title: Only what you truly need
values.source: recommending only what our patients truly need
values.description: We recommend the treatment a patient actually needs, and say so plainly when a procedure can wait or is not required at all.

values.title: Care that stays affordable
values.source: affordable, ethical, and uncompromised quality care
values.description: Affordability is built into how treatment is planned rather than applied at the end, and costs are explained before anything is scheduled.

values.title: A patient-first culture
values.description: Compassion is part of the clinical work: unhurried explanations, questions answered in your own language, and time for the family.

values.title: Evidence and modern technology
values.description: Skilled consultants read modern diagnostics and follow evidence-based medicine, so a plan can be explained as well as recommended.

values.title: The same standard everywhere
values.source: consistent quality across every Aakash Eye Hospital
values.description: One set of clinical protocols across every Aakash Eye Hospital, so the care is the same at whichever hospital you visit.

values.title: Always learning
values.description: The team keeps learning, improving and innovating, so the next generation of patients is served better than the last.
